hook: Open a day from your health history.
thumbnail: Open a day from the diary
caption: Your health history kept like an archive of days. Open one, and the whole day unfolds on a single page: pulse readings, mood, sleep, every log where it belongs. Not a list of cards, a place to come back to. Explore the health diary. #HealthDiary #HealthGraph #DailyHealth #HealthJournal #HealthHistory #DailyLog #PulseCheck #Wellness #HealthTracking

lines.text: Open a day from your health history.
lines.beat: a stack of cream paper daily reports sits on a desk-lit surface; light catches the top report's edge

lines.text: It doesn't look like a list of cards.
lines.beat: a ghost of a flat card-list UI dissolves into paper texture, establishing the archive, not a card list

lines.text: It looks like the day itself.
lines.beat: close-up on the top paper report's edge; '3 OCT Today' catches the light

lines.text: The paper rises out of the stack.
lines.beat: HERO: the paper report lifts out of the stack with a slow tilt, floating above the archive

lines.text: It unfolds slowly, until the day fills the screen.
lines.beat: the report unfolds, growing until it fills two-thirds of the frame

lines.text: Saturday, October third: pulse, fifty nine beats per minute, at five fourteen in the afternoon.
lines.beat: the pulse line fills in on the paper: Pulse 59 BPM · Fair 5:14 PM, in a quiet serif

lines.text: A second reading, sixty one beats per minute, from the fingertip.
lines.beat: the second row fills: ALSO Pulse — Fingertip 61 BPM · Fair

lines.text: Mood of the day: very good. Sleep: seven hours.
lines.beat: the lower block unfolds: mood 'Very good', sleep 7h, the '3 events' history row

lines.text: Six logs sit on the same page, tap to open.
lines.beat: the footer 'Log ×6, tap to open' taps; a small log card lifts up from the page

lines.text: Every day becomes a page you can come back to.
lines.beat: camera drifts back over the stack; many days, each one a paper page
end card: the paper report settled on top of the stack with the CTA beneath
